as_told.title: Hieroglyphics test run by Amelia's spelling therapist and babysitter

plain: Amelia, a girl in the Midwest who communicates by spelling out words, was shown some Hebrew, read it and typed out what it meant, and when asked who taught her Hebrew she typed "the rabbi"; she also identified hieroglyphics she had never seen. Her mother, Mora, tells this on the show in her own words, as something that happened at home and was part of The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary about children said to read minds. The filmmaker behind it, Ky Dickens, retells it differently, saying the hieroglyphics test was run by Amelia's spelling therapist and babysitter.
